security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Contribute data to Onyx (test network); your API keys stay on your computer
bundle.longDescription: The Onyx contributor app for the test network (Base Sepolia, no real money): keep your API keys in your computer's keychain, read values from those APIs on your computer, and propose them to Onyx after you confirm. Optionally adds Onyx to Claude Desktop.
